cases.name: Ashley Real
cases.about: “She loved to help people. She would never hurt somebody,” (her father Jose Real) said. “She was only 22.”
cases.narrative: On 5/7/2023, a fisherman found her body in a heavily wooded area near Eagle Creek, off Southeast Judd Road in rural Clackamas County, OR.
